title: TCL 50C725K (reports as "Smart TV Pro", device BeyondTV4, product BeyondTV6, board RTD2851M, Realtek rtd288o), 2 GB RAM
header:
TCL 50C725K (reports as "Smart TV Pro", device BeyondTV4, product BeyondTV6, board RTD2851M, Realtek rtd288o), 2 GB RAM
Android TV 11 (SDK 30) with the older com.google.android.tvlauncher, build RP1A.200622.001, fingerprint
TCL/BeyondTV6/BeyondTV4:11/RP1A.200622.001/AR10:user/release-keys.
Same BeyondTV4 device as examples/tcl-65c725 and examples/tcl-55c725 (that one runs launcherx).
Applied on a real unit on 2026-10-20/21 with launcher/ as Home; the list below survived a reboot.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/tcl-50c725k/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/tcl-50c725k/debloat.txt
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher; launcher/build-and-install.sh disables it, it is not listed.
Live TV app: com.tcl.tv (kept; set live_tv_package to it in launcher config.xml). Inputs: com.tcl.tvinput (kept).
Never disable (same platform as examples/tcl-43c645): com.tcl.providers.config com.tcl.initsetup
com.tcl.system.server com.tcl.tcl_bt_rcu_service com.tcl.autopair com.tcl.tvinput com.tcl.tv com.tcl.settings
com.tcl.inputmethod.international. Also kept: com.tcl.usercenter (TCL account), com.tcl.versionUpdateApp
(firmware updater), com.tcl.miracast and com.google.android.apps.mediashell (Chromecast), com.tcl.MultiScreenInteraction_TV,
com.google.android.backdrop (screensaver), com.google.android.tungsten.setupwraith.
